parts.text:
30 An electron is in an electric field of strength 5 × 104
V m–1. The field is the only influence on the
electron.
The mass and charge of an electron are known.
Which quantity can be calculated without any more information?
A
the force on the electron
B
the momentum of the electron
C
the kinetic energy of the electron
D
the speed of the electron

hints: Notice what is given: electric field strength $E = 5 \times 10^4 \text{ V m}^{-1}$ plus known electron charge $e$ and mass $m$, with no time, distance or speed.
Connect field strength to force with $F = qE$ for a charge in a uniform electric field.
Ask what momentum, kinetic energy and speed all require - the velocity $v$ - and check whether $E$ alone gives you $v$ without time or distance moved.
walkthrough: Identify the given data: $E = 5 \times 10^4 \text{ V m}^{-1}$, electron charge $q = -e$ with magnitude $e$, and electron mass $m$. No initial speed, time or displacement is stated.
State the governing rule for a charge in an electric field: force $F = qE$ in magnitude $F = eE$. This needs only charge and field strength.
Substitute values: $F = e \times 5 \times 10^4 \text{ N}$, giving a force in newtons with no other data needed.
Check the other quantities: momentum $p = mv$, kinetic energy $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, and speed $v$ all require $v$.
Velocity would need how long the force has acted or how far the electron has moved, using $a = F/m$ plus kinematics or $E_k = qV$, but time and distance are missing.
Therefore only the force is fully determined from the stated information. This is option A.

A.explanation: Force follows directly from $F = qE$ using the given $5 \times 10^4 \text{ V m}^{-1}$ and known electron charge $e$.

B.explanation: Momentum $p = mv$ needs the electron speed $v$, which is not given and cannot be found from field strength alone.

C.explanation: Kinetic energy $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$ needs speed, or $qV$ needs potential difference, and neither $v$ nor distance is given.

D.explanation: Speed cannot be found because the time of acceleration or distance moved in the field is not given.
